body.x: JJ&Companies Inc. (CEO Jeon JoungHo) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will exhibit in the K-Startup Pavilion.

JJ&Companies specializes in marine engineering, leveraging the expertise of its founder and team, who have extensive experience in advanced marine plant control systems, engineering, and sales with a Norwegian state-owned enterprise. Combining AI, software, and process control technologies, the company offers automation solutions that promote efficient and sustainable water resource management while prioritizing environmental protection and safety.

The company’s business scope encompasses underwater monitoring systems, eco-friendly ship fuel supply control systems, marine energy generation, and industrial safety monitoring. Its solutions aim to create safer and more environmentally friendly marine systems, aligning with its motto: "The best technology is that which keeps people and the environment safe."

JJ&Companies has conducted in-depth research on key aquatic species, such as Atlantic salmon and flatfish, focusing on their life cycles, behavioral anomalies, and disease analysis. Collaborating with institutions like the Gangwon-do Inland Water Resource Center and the Busan Marine Resources Research Institute, they have delivered solutions to prominent fisheries research facilities in Korea. Internationally, the company partners with the University of Wisconsin’s Freshwater Institute to analyze the ecology of species in Lake Michigan and works with Korea Water Resources Corporation to build a big data-driven aquatic ecosystem monitoring system.

Their AI and big data-powered solutions predict water quality changes and biodiversity risks, offering real-time preventive measures for conservation and resource management. These technologies are expected to benefit aquaculture standardization, environmental policy responses, underwater infrastructure evaluations, and maritime safety. Ultimately, JJ&Companies aims to provide sustainable water-energy-food nexus solutions for global markets.

At CES 2025, the company will introduce its flagship technology, VIITS (Vision Intelligence for Intelligent Tracking Systems). This AI-based underwater monitoring system uses a single-lens underwater camera to detect and collect data on aquatic organisms, analyzing key biological indicators such as biomass, growth patterns, and habitat conditions. VIITS boasts an analysis accuracy of over 95%, with flexible installation and user-friendly maintenance. A customizable dashboard and cloud-based service enhance accessibility for end-users.

JJ&Companies emphasizes VIITS’s versatility and scalability. The system integrates with various sensors and cameras, providing seamless installation and maintenance. Its advanced deep-learning algorithms offer precise observations, even in murky waters or overlapping conditions, enabling environmental monitoring, aquaculture optimization, and predictive management of ecosystem health in response to climate change.

The company plans to leverage CES 2025 to partner with global investors, collaborators, and research institutions. By showcasing VIITS, JJ&Companies seeks to secure a foothold in international markets, focusing on regions such as North America and Europe, where demand for sustainable aquatic ecosystem management solutions is rising.

Plans include expanding participation in major U.S. exhibitions and conferences to increase visibility and customer engagement. The company also aims to enhance its network by utilizing government and private support programs to facilitate market entry. Collaboration with leading marine research institutions and universities in the U.S. will drive innovation and product development, ensuring the flexibility to address region-specific challenges.

JJ&Companies envisions providing a comprehensive system that encompasses hardware (sensors and IoT devices), software (data collection and analytics), and related services (maintenance and upgrades). By offering subscription models to organizations such as conservation agencies, research institutions, and large-scale fisheries, the company aims to deliver actionable insights into marine environmental changes and support customers’ sustainability goals.
Through VIITS, JJ&Companies aspires to help global businesses achieve their ESG objectives, paving the way for sustainable marine management ecosystems worldwide.
